verdict.rationale: Mastra's workflow engine supports parallel steps (.parallel()) and branching, which could enable processing multiple items concurrently, but there's no explicit documentation of bulk/batch operations across many items (e.g., batch APIs, list processing primitives, or iteration constructs for large item sets). missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk operation APIs, documented iteration-over-collections primitives, evidence of handling large item sets efficiently, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
